import time
from gpiozero import Button
from picamera2 import Picamera2
from paho.mqtt import client as mqtt

# Initialize I2C bus
i2c = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# MPU6050 I2C address
MPU6050_ADDRESS = 0x68

# Register addresses
ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F
TEMP_OUT_H = 0x41

# Function to read raw data from MPU6050
def read_mpu6050():
    try:
        # Read accelerometer data
        accel_xout = i2c.read_word_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, ACCEL_XOUT_H)
        accel_yout = i2c.read_word_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, ACCEL_YOUT_H)
        accel_zout = i2c.read_word_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, ACCEL_ZOUT_H)
        
        # Read temperature data
        temp_out = i2c.read_word_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, TEMP_OUT_H)
        
        # Convert to signed 16-bit values
        accel_x = accel_xout >> 8 | (accel_xout & 0xFF) << 8
        accel_y = accel_yout >> 8 | (accel_yout & 0xFF) << 8
        accel_z = accel_zout >> 8 | (accel_zout & 0xFF) << 8
        temp = temp_out >> 8 | (temp_out & 0xFF) << 8
        
        return accel_x, accel_y, accel_z, temp
    except OSError:
        print("Error: MPU6050 not found.")
        return None

# Function to handle button press
def button_pressed():
    print("Button pressed, exiting...")
    exit(0)

# Set up button
button = Button(17)
button.when_pressed = button_pressed

# Main loop
try:
    while True:
        readings = read_mpu6050()
        if readings is not None:
            accel_x, accel_y, accel_z, temp = readings
            print(f"Accel X: {accel_x}, Accel Y: {accel_y}, Accel Z: {accel_z}, Temp: {temp}")
        time.sleep(0.01)
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    print("Program interrupted by user.")
finally:
    # Release hardware resources
    i2c.close()
    button.close()

# Initialize I2C bus
i2c = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# Define MPU6050 addresses
MPU6050_ADDRESS = 0x68

# Define MPU6050 registers
ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
ACCEL_XOUT_L = 0x3C
ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_YOUT_L = 0x3E
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F
ACCEL_ZOUT_L = 0x40
TEMP_OUT_H = 0x41
TEMP_OUT_L = 0x42
GYRO_XOUT_H = 0x43
GYRO_XOUT_L = 0x44
GYRO_YOUT_H = 0x45
GYRO_YOUT_L = 0x46
GYRO_ZOUT_H = 0x47
GYRO_ZOUT_L = 0x48

# Function to read 16-bit signed value from MPU6050
def read_s16(reg):
    high = i2c.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, reg)
    low = i2c.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, reg + 1)
    return (high << 8) | low

# Function to read temperature from MPU6050
def read_temperature():
    raw_temp = read_s16(TEMP_OUT_H)
    # Scale the raw temperature to degrees Celsius
    temp_celsius = (raw_temp / 340.0) + 36.53
    return temp_celsius

# Function to read accelerometer data from MPU6050
def read_accelerometer():
    accel_x = read_s16(ACCEL_XOUT_H)
    accel_y = read_s16(ACCEL_YOUT_H)
    accel_z = read_s16(ACCEL_ZOUT_H)
    # Scale the raw accelerometer values to g
    accel_x_g = accel_x / 16384.0
    accel_y_g = accel_y / 16384.0
    accel_z_g = accel_z / 16384.0
    return accel_x_g, accel_y_g, accel_z_g

# Function to read gyroscope data from MPU6050
def read_gyroscope():
    gyro_x = read_s16(GYRO_XOUT_H)
    gyro_y = read_s16(GYRO_YOUT_H)
    gyro_z = read_s16(GYRO_ZOUT_H)
    # Scale the raw gyroscope values to degrees per second
    gyro_x_dps = gyro_x / 131.0
    gyro_y_dps = gyro_y / 131.0
    gyro_z_dps = gyro_z / 131.0
    return gyro_x_dps, gyro_y_dps, gyro_z_dps

# Function to check if MPU6050 is present
def check_mpu6050():
    try:
        i2c.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, 0x75)
        return True
    except OSError:
        return False

# Main loop
if check_mpu6050():
    print("MPU6050 detected.")
    while True:
        try:
            temp = read_temperature()
            accel_x, accel_y, accel_z = read_accelerometer()
            gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z = read_gyroscope()
            print(f"Temperature: {temp:.2f}°C")
            print(f"Accelerometer: X={accel_x:.2f}g, Y={accel_y:.2f}g, Z={accel_z:.2f}g")
            print(f"Gyroscope: X={gyro_x:.2f}°/s, Y={gyro_y:.2f}°/s, Z={gyro_z:.2f}°/s")
            time.sleep(0.05)
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            break
else:
    print("MPU6050 not detected. Exiting.")
    exit(1)

# Clean up GPIO and I2C
try:
    i2c.close()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error closing I2C bus: {e}")

# Define TSL2561 I2C address
TSL2561_ADDRESS = 0x39

# Define TSL2561 registers
TSL2561_COMMAND_BIT = 0xA0
TSL2561_REGISTER_CONTROL = 0x00
TSL2561_REGISTER_TIMING = 0x01
TSL2561_REGISTER_DATA_LOW = 0x0C
TSL2561_REGISTER_DATA_HIGH = 0x0D

# Define TSL2561 gain settings
TSL2561_GAIN_1X = 0x00
TSL2561_GAIN_16X = 0x10

# Define TSL2561 integration times
TSL2561_INTEGRATIONTIME_13MS = 0x00
TSL2561_INTEGRATIONTIME_101MS = 0x01
TSL2561_INTEGRATIONTIME_402MS = 0x02

# Define TSL2561 data valid mask
TSL2561_DATA_VALID_MASK = 0x01

# Function to read TSL2561 data
def read_tsl2561():
    try:
        # Set control register to start conversion
        i2c.write_byte_data(TSL2561_ADDRESS, TSL2561_COMMAND_BIT | TSL2561_REGISTER_CONTROL, 0x03)
        
        # Wait for conversion to complete

        # Read low and high byte of data
        low_byte = i2c.read_byte_data(TSL2561_ADDRESS, TSL2561_COMMAND_BIT | TSL2561_REGISTER_DATA_LOW)
        high_byte = i2c.read_byte_data(TSL2561_ADDRESS, TSL2561_COMMAND_BIT | TSL2561_REGISTER_DATA_HIGH)
        
        # Combine low and high bytes into a 16-bit value
        data = (high_byte << 8) | low_byte
        
        # Check if data is valid
        if data & TSL2561_DATA_VALID_MASK == 0:
            raise ValueError("Data is invalid")
        
        return data
    
    except smbus2.SMBusError as e:
        print(f"Error reading TSL2561: {e}")
        return None

    try:
        mqtt_client.publish("sensor/tsl2561", message)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error publishing MQTT message: {e}")

# Main loop

    while True:
        # Read TSL2561 data
        data = read_tsl2561()
        
        if data is not None:
            # Convert data to lux
            lux = data * 0.004572
            
            # Publish MQTT message
            publish_mqtt(f"{lux:.2f} lux")
            
            # Print to standard output

except KeyboardInterrupt:

finally:

# Initialize TSL2561 sensor

TSL2561_COMMAND_BIT = 0xA0
TSL2561_REGISTER_CONTROL = 0x00
TSL2561_REGISTER_TIMING = 0x01
TSL2561_REGISTER_DATA_LOW = 0x0C
TSL2561_REGISTER_DATA_HIGH = 0x0D

def read_tsl2561():
    # Set integration time to 130ms
    i2c.write_byte_data(TSL2561_ADDR, TSL2561_REGISTER_TIMING, 0x00)
    
    # Start conversion
    i2c.write_byte_data(TSL2561_ADDR, TSL2561_REGISTER_CONTROL, 0x03)

    # Read low byte

    # Combine bytes into a 16-bit value

    return lux

REG_DIG_T2 = 0x8A
REG_DIG_T3 = 0x8C
REG_DIG_P1 = 0x8E
REG_DIG_P2 = 0x90
REG_DIG_P3 = 0x92
REG_DIG_P4 = 0x94
REG_DIG_P5 = 0x96
REG_DIG_P6 = 0x98
REG_DIG_P7 = 0x9A
REG_DIG_P8 = 0x9C
REG_DIG_P9 = 0x9E
REG_DIG_H1 = 0xA1
REG_DIG_H2 = 0xA2
REG_DIG_H3 = 0xA3
REG_DIG_H4 = 0xA4
REG_DIG_H5 = 0xA5
REG_DIG_H6 = 0xA6
REG_STATUS = 0xF3
REG_CTRL_MEAS = 0xF4
REG_CONFIG = 0xF5
REG_PRESSURE_MSB = 0xF7
REG_PRESSURE_LSB = 0xF8
REG_PRESSURE_XLSB = 0xF9
REG_TEMPERATURE_MSB = 0xFA
REG_TEMPERATURE_LSB = 0xFB
REG_TEMPERATURE_XLSB = 0xFC
REG_HUMIDITY_MSB = 0xFD
REG_HUMIDITY_LSB = 0xFE

# BMP280 calibration data
calibration_data = {}

def read_calibration_data():
    for reg in [REG_DIG_T1, REG_DIG_T2, REG_DIG_T3, REG_DIG_P1, REG_DIG_P2, REG_DIG_P3, REG_DIG_P4, REG_DIG_P5, REG_DIG_P6, REG_DIG_P7, REG_DIG_P8, REG_DIG_P9, REG_DIG_H1, REG_DIG_H2, REG_DIG_H3, REG_DIG_H4, REG_DIG_H5, REG_DIG_H6]:
        calibration_data[reg] = i2c.read_word_data(BMP280_I2C_ADDR, reg)

def calculate_temperature(pressure, temperature):
    # Calculate temperature using the calibration data
    # This is a simplified version and may need adjustments based on actual calibration data
    t_fine = ((temperature & 0xFFFF) - calibration_data[REG_DIG_T1]) * calibration_data[REG_DIG_T2] / 2**16
    t_fine += ((t_fine >> 3) * t_fine * calibration_data[REG_DIG_T3]) / 2**12
    t_fine += ((t_fine >> 13) * t_fine * calibration_data[REG_DIG_T4]) / 2**13
    t_fine -= ((t_fine >> 22) * t_fine * calibration_data[REG_DIG_T5]) / 2**16
    t_fine = (t_fine + 8) >> 4
    return t_fine / 5120.0

def calculate_pressure(pressure, temperature):

    var1 = t_fine - 128000
    var2 = var1 * var1 * calibration_data[REG_DIG_P6]
    var2 += var1 * calibration_data[REG_DIG_P5] * 2
    var2 += calibration_data[REG_DIG_P4]
    var1 = (var1 * var1 * calibration_data[REG_DIG_P3]) / 2**16
    var1 += (var1 * calibration_data[REG_DIG_P2]) / 2**13
    var1 += calibration_data[REG_DIG_P1]
    var1 = (var1 * 2) / 2**15
    if var1 == 0:

    p *= 2048
    p /= var1
    p += calibration_data[REG_DIG_P9]
    p *= 2
    p /= calibration_data[REG_DIG_P8]
    p += 32768
    p = p / 65536
    return p

        temperature_raw |= i2c.read_byte_data(BMP280_I2C_ADDR, REG_TEMPERATURE_XLSB)

import smbus2

import sys

# Define the I2C bus number and the MPU6050 address
I2C_BUS = 1
MPU6050_ADDRESS = 0x68

# Initialize the I2C bus
try:
    bus = smbus2.SMBus(I2C_BUS)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Error: I2C bus not found.")
    sys.exit(1)

# Function to read a 16-bit signed integer from the MPU6050
def read_s16(address):
    high = bus.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, address)
    low = bus.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, address + 1)
    return (high << 8) | low

# Function to read a 16-bit unsigned integer from the MPU6050
def read_u16(address):
    high = bus.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, address)
    low = bus.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, address + 1)
    return (high << 8) | low

# Function to read a 32-bit signed integer from the MPU6050
def read_s32(address):
    high = bus.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, address)
    mid = bus.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, address + 1)
    low = bus.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, address + 2)
    lsb = bus.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, address + 3)
    return (high << 24) | (mid << 16) | (low << 8) | lsb

# Function to read the accelerometer data
def read_accel():
    x = read_s16(0x3B)
    y = read_s16(0x3D)
    z = read_s16(0x3F)
    return x, y, z

# Function to read the gyroscope data
def read_gyro():
    x = read_s16(0x43)
    y = read_s16(0x45)
    z = read_s16(0x47)
    return x, y, z

# Function to read the temperature data
def read_temp():
    raw_temp = read_s16(0x41)
    temp_c = (raw_temp / 340.0) + 36.53
    return temp_c

# Function to read all sensor data
def read_all():
    accel_x, accel_y, accel_z = read_accel()
    gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z = read_gyro()
    temp = read_temp()
    return accel_x, accel_y, accel_z, gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z, temp

# Signal handler to release hardware resources on exit
def signal_handler(sig, frame):
    try:
        bus.close()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error closing I2C bus: {e}")
    sys.exit(0)

# Register the signal handler
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)

# Main loop to read sensor data
try:
    for _ in range(5):
        accel_x, accel_y, accel_z, gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z, temp = read_all()
        print(f"Accel: X={accel_x}, Y={accel_y}, Z={accel_z}")
        print(f"Gyro: X={gyro_x}, Y={gyro_y}, Z={gyro_z}")
        print(f"Temp: {temp:.2f}°C")
        sleep(0.1)
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    pass

# Release hardware resources on exit
try:
    bus.close()
except Exception as e:

GYRO_YOUT_L = 0x46

    high = i2c.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, reg)

ina219_address = 0x17
ina219_config = 0x40 | (0b00 << 6) | (0b00 << 3) | (0b00 << 0)  # 12-bit resolution, no averaging

mqtt_client.connect("mqtt.example.com", 1883, 60)

    try:
        # Write configuration to INA219

        # Read current value
        current_lsb = i2c.read_word_data(ina219_address, 0x01)
        current_msb = i2c.read_word_data(ina219_address, 0x02)
        current_value = (current_msb << 8) | current_lsb
        
        # Convert to current in mA

        return current_mA

    print("Program interrupted by button press.")

import smbus2
from time import sleep

# Initialize I2C bus
i2c = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# Define PCA9685 registers
PCA9685_MODE1 = 0x00
PCA9685_MODE2 = 0x01
PCA9685_SUBADR1 = 0x02
PCA9685_SUBADR2 = 0x03
PCA9685_SUBADR3 = 0x04
PCA9685_ALLCALLADDR = 0x05
PCA9685_LEADTIME = 0x06
PCA9685_PRESCALE = 0x07
PCA9685_TESTMODE = 0x08
PCA9685_LED0_ON_L = 0x08
PCA9685_LED0_ON_H = 0x09
PCA9685_LED0_OFF_L = 0x0A
PCA9685_LED0_OFF_H = 0x0B
PCA9685_ALLLED_ON_L = 0xFA
PCA9685_ALLLED_ON_H = 0xFB
PCA9685_ALLLED_OFF_L = 0xFC
PCA9685_ALLLED_OFF_H = 0xFD

# Set up PCA9685
def setup_pca9685():
    # Set mode1 register to enable auto-increment
    i2c.write_byte_data(0x40, PCA9685_MODE1, 0x01)
    # Set mode2 register to enable all channels
    i2c.write_byte_data(0x40, PCA9685_MODE2, 0x00)

# Read a PWM value from a specific channel
def read_pwm(channel):
    if channel < 0 or channel > 15:
        raise ValueError("Channel must be between 0 and 15")
    # Calculate the register address for the PWM value
    reg = PCA9685_LED0_ON_L + (channel * 4)
    # Read the PWM value
    on_l = i2c.read_byte_data(0x40, reg)
    on_h = i2c.read_byte_data(0x40, reg + 1)
    off_l = i2c.read_byte_data(0x40, reg + 2)
    off_h = i2c.read_byte_data(0x40, reg + 3)
    # Combine the high and low bytes into a single 16-bit value
    pwm_value = ((on_h << 8) | on_l) - ((off_h << 8) | off_l)
    return pwm_value

# Main function
def main():
    try:
        setup_pca9685()
        # Read and print PWM values for all channels
        for channel in range(16):
            pwm_value = read_pwm(channel)
            print(f"Channel {channel}: {pwm_value}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
    finally:
        # Release hardware resources
        i2c.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Define constants
MPU6050_ADDRESS = 0x68
ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F
TEMP_OUT_H = 0x41
PWR_MGMT_1 = 0x6B

# Function to read a 16-bit signed integer from the MPU6050
def read_s16(data):
    return (data[0] << 8) | data[1]

# Function to read a 16-bit unsigned integer from the MPU6050
def read_u16(data):
    return (data[0] << 8) | data[1]

# Function to read a temperature value from the MPU6050
def read_temperature():
    data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, TEMP_OUT_H, 2)
    temp_raw = read_s16(data)
    # Convert raw temperature to degrees Celsius
    temp_celsius = temp_raw / 340.0 + 36.53
    return temp_celsius

# Function to read accelerometer values from the MPU6050
def read_accelerometer():
    data = bus.read_i2c_block_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, ACCEL_XOUT_H, 6)
    accel_x = read_s16(data[0:2])
    accel_y = read_s16(data[2:4])
    accel_z = read_s16(data[4:6])
    return accel_x, accel_y, accel_z

# Function to initialize the MPU6050
def init_mpu6050():
    # Wake up the MPU6050
    bus.write_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, PWR_MGMT_1, 0x00)
    sleep(0.1)

# Function to handle SIGINT (Ctrl+C) to clean up
def signal_handler(sig, frame):
    print("Exiting...")
    cleanup()
    sys.exit(0)

# Function to clean up GPIO and I2C resources
def cleanup():
    global bus
    if bus:
        bus.close()

# Main function
if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        # Initialize the I2C bus
        bus = smbus2.SMBus(1)
        
        # Initialize the MPU6050
        init_mpu6050()
        
        # Read and print temperature
        temp = read_temperature()
        print(f"Temperature: {temp:.2f}°C")
        
        # Read and print accelerometer values
        accel_x, accel_y, accel_z = read_accelerometer()
        print(f"Accelerometer: X={accel_x}, Y={accel_y}, Z={accel_z}")
    
    except smbus2.SMBusError as e:
        print(f"Error reading from MPU6050: {e}")

import smbus2
import time
from gpiozero import Button
from picamera2 import Picamera2
from paho.mqtt.client import Client

# Initialize I2C bus
i2c = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# MPU6050 I2C address
MPU6050_ADDRESS = 0x68

# Register addresses
ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F
TEMP_OUT_H = 0x41
GYRO_XOUT_H = 0x43
GYRO_YOUT_H = 0x45
GYRO_ZOUT_H = 0x47

# MPU6050 register configuration
ACCEL_CONFIG = 0x1C
GYRO_CONFIG = 0x1B
PWR_MGMT_1 = 0x6B

# MPU6050 accelerometer sensitivity
ACCEL_SENSITIVITY = 16384.0

# MPU6050 gyroscope sensitivity
GYRO_SENSITIVITY = 131.0

# Function to read raw data from MPU6050
def read_raw_data(register):
    high = i2c.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, register)
    low = i2c.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, register + 1)
    value = (high << 8) | low
    return value

# Function to convert raw data to acceleration in g
def accel_to_g(raw_data):
    return raw_data / ACCEL_SENSITIVITY

# Function to convert raw data to gyroscope in degrees per second
def gyro_to_dps(raw_data):
    return raw_data / GYRO_SENSITIVITY

# Function to check if MPU6050 is present
def check_mpu6050():
    try:
        i2c.read_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, 0x75)
        return True
    except OSError:
        return False

# Function to read MPU6050 data
def read_mpu6050():
    accel_x = accel_to_g(read_raw_data(ACCEL_XOUT_H))
    accel_y = accel_to_g(read_raw_data(ACCEL_YOUT_H))
    accel_z = accel_to_g(read_raw_data(ACCEL_ZOUT_H))
    temp = read_raw_data(TEMP_OUT_H)
    gyro_x = gyro_to_dps(read_raw_data(GYRO_XOUT_H))
    gyro_y = gyro_to_dps(read_raw_data(GYRO_YOUT_H))
    gyro_z = gyro_to_dps(read_raw_data(GYRO_ZOUT_H))
    return accel_x, accel_y, accel_z, temp, gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z

# Function to publish data to MQTT broker
def publish_data(client, topic, data):
    try:
        client.publish(topic, data)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error publishing data: {e}")

# Main function
def main():
    if not check_mpu6050():
        print("MPU6050 not found")
        exit(1)

    # Set up I2C configuration
    i2c.write_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, PWR_MGMT_1, 0x00)  # Wake up MPU6050
    i2c.write_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, ACCEL_CONFIG, 0x00)  # Set accelerometer full scale range to ±2g
    i2c.write_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, GYRO_CONFIG, 0x00)  # Set gyroscope full scale range to ±250°/s

    # Set up MQTT client
    client = Client()
    client.connect("mqtt.example.com", 1883, 60)
    client.loop_start()

    # Set up button to exit
    button = Button(17)
    button.when_pressed = lambda: exit(0)

    try:
        for _ in range(8):
            accel_x, accel_y, accel_z, temp, gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z = read_mpu6050()
            print(f"Accel X: {accel_x:.2f} g, Y: {accel_y:.2f} g, Z: {accel_z:.2f} g")
            print(f"Gyro X: {gyro_x:.2f} °/s, Y: {gyro_y:.2f} °/s, Z: {gyro_z:.2f} °/s")
            print(f"Temp: {temp:.2f} °C")

            # Publish data to MQTT broker
            publish_data(client, "sensor/mpu6050", f"{accel_x},{accel_y},{accel_z},{temp},{gyro_x},{gyro_y},{gyro_z}")

            time.sleep(0.1)
    finally:
        # Release hardware resources
        i2c.close()
        client.loop_stop()
        client.disconnect()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

TSL2591_REGISTER_DATA_LOW = 0x0C
TSL2591_REGISTER_DATA_HIGH = 0x0D

TSL2591_GAIN_16X = 0x10

TSL2591_INTEGRATIONTIME_800MS = 0x03

import smbus2
import time
from gpiozero import Button
from picamera2 import Picamera2
from paho.mqtt.client import Client

# Initialize I2C bus
i2c = smbus2.SMBus(1)

# Define ADXL345 I2C address
ADXL345_ADDRESS = 0x1d

# Initialize GPIO pin for button
button = Button(17)

# Initialize MQTT client
mqtt_client = Client("adxl345_reader")
mqtt_client.connect("mqtt.example.com", 1883, 60)

try:
    # Read ADXL345 configuration register
    config = i2c.read_byte_data(ADXL345_ADDRESS, 0x31)
    
    # Check if device is present
    if config == 0x00:
        print("ADXL345 not found.")
        mqtt_client.publish("adxl345/status", "not_found")
        mqtt_client.disconnect()
        exit(1)
    
    # Set ADXL345 to 16-bit range
    i2c.write_byte_data(ADXL345_ADDRESS, 0x31, 0x08)
    
    # Start continuous data acquisition
    i2c.write_byte_data(ADXL345_ADDRESS, 0x2D, 0x08)
    
    while True:
        try:
            # Read X, Y, Z axis data
            x = i2c.read_word_data(ADXL345_ADDRESS, 0x32)
            y = i2c.read_word_data(ADXL345_ADDRESS, 0x34)
            z = i2c.read_word_data(ADXL345_ADDRESS, 0x36)
            
            # Print readings
            print(f"X: {x}, Y: {y}, Z: {z}")
            
            # Publish readings to MQTT
            mqtt_client.publish("adxl345/acceleration", f"{x},{y},{z}")
        
        except OSError as e:
            print(f"Error reading from ADXL345: {e}")
            mqtt_client.publish("adxl345/status", "error")
        
        # Wait for 1 second
        time.sleep(1)
        
        # Check for button press to exit
        if button.is_pressed:
            print("Button pressed, exiting...")
            break
    
finally:
    # Stop continuous data acquisition
    i2c.write_byte_data(ADXL345_ADDRESS, 0x2D, 0x00)
    
    # Release hardware resources
    i2c.close()
    mqtt_client.disconnect()
